name: 🥚 Veggie & Cheese Omelets
what: One big cheesy veggie omelet, finished under the broiler and cut into wedges.
extras: baby spinach, milk, english muffins, butter

moves.text: Pull the must-haves onto the counter. Broiler on.
Whisk 10 eggs with a splash of milk, salt and pepper.
Butter in an oven-safe nonstick pan on medium. Cook the veggies soft.
Pour in the eggs. Lift the edges so raw egg runs under.
Cheese on top, under the broiler until puffy and golden. Cut in wedges.

key: The broiler sets the top, so nobody has to flip it. Use an oven mitt on that handle.
done: Puffed, golden, and the middle doesn't jiggle.
plan_b: No oven-safe pan? Make scrambled eggs with the veggies and cheese stirred in.
